vectors.description: ODE solver on TV-INT-1 matches the analytic value; observed order from step halving.

inputs.solver: Radau or LSODA, breakpoint at every segment boundary

our_recomputation.statement: matches the analytic value within the solver tolerance; observed order p from step halving matches the method order to about 2 significant figures (MDS52)

tolerance.basis: solver tolerance as configured; 1e-8 rel is the suggested acceptance for rtol 1e-10

vectors.note: Code verification: observed order p = log(E1/E2)/log(r); do not expect the theoretical order to more than two or three significant figures (MDS52).
